teaching_methods.name: The Office Protocol
teaching_methods.description: Watch 1 hour of The Office S01E01 — understand Western humor for social/business contexts

teaching_methods.name: English-Only Rule
teaching_methods.description: Ban Vietnamese in class to break in-head translation habit — think directly in English

teaching_methods.name: 30% Slower Challenge
teaching_methods.description: Speak 30% slower for clarity and calmness — conscious speed control

teaching_methods.name: Island Survival
teaching_methods.description: Hypothetical scenario: stranded on island, choose 3 items — forces creative English use

teaching_methods.name: Mock Job Interview
teaching_methods.description: Choose which utensil you'd be and justify — creative reasoning in English

teaching_methods.name: Hypothetical Dilemmas
teaching_methods.description: Would-you-rather scenarios — forces quick answer + justification

teaching_methods.name: Company Pitch
teaching_methods.description: 1-minute pitch for BlueTech — why do business with them — professional English practice

teaching_methods.name: Conversational Scaffolding
teaching_methods.description: Coach reciprocal questions ("And you?") to keep conversations going

teaching_methods.name: Monthly Social Event
teaching_methods.description: Adult students drink beer and talk in English — natural practice environment

teaching_methods.name: Filler Word Correction
teaching_methods.description: Identify and correct "uh" filler habit — pause instead, or use confident fillers

teaching_methods.name: S/SH Minimal Pairs & Tongue Twisters
teaching_methods.description: "She sells seashells" + word pairs — differentiate s and sh sounds

teaching_methods.name: 3-Tries Rule
teaching_methods.description: Try 3 times in English before resorting to Vietnamese

teaching_methods.name: "I Don't Know" Celebration
teaching_methods.description: Celebrate when students say "I don't know" instead of freezing — breakthrough moment

teaching_methods.name: Self-Observation
teaching_methods.description: Watch yourself speak — become your own teacher by noticing habits

verbatim_quotes.text: Students must learn to say something to practice their English
Watching a sitcom is important for understanding Western humor and jokes, which is powerful and important in social and business contexts
If you can hear when you do it... you become your own teacher
I want the first habit to be: being okay with making mistakes
Try solving the problem three times in English before resorting to Vietnamese

key_concepts.name: Mouse-to-Tiger Progression Evidence
key_concepts.description: Tiên Truong CUB→MOUSE upgrade — "I don't know" breakthrough as concrete level-up marker

key_concepts.name: Anti-Shame Permission Culture
key_concepts.description: Celebrating mistakes as breakthroughs, not failures. First habit = being okay with making mistakes

key_concepts.name: Scaffolded Autonomy
key_concepts.description: Self-observation method + 3-tries rule = students becoming their own teachers over time

key_concepts.name: Social Immersion Architecture
key_concepts.description: Buddy program + monthly social events + The Office Protocol = multi-channel English exposure outside classroom

key_concepts.name: Phonics Anchor System
key_concepts.description: S/SH minimal pairs, tongue twisters as diagnostic + correction tools for Vietnamese speakers

consolidation_targets.STUDENT_PROFILES: 6 updated profiles with levels, habits, challenges
consolidation_targets.CORE_PRINCIPLES: Mouse → Tiger progression evidence, "I don't know" celebration
